tools.name: open
tools.description: Open an app, a web address, or a file or folder on the person's Mac. Web addresses open in their own browser.

target.description: An app name like Spotify, a web address, or a file or folder like Downloads.

tools.name: files
tools.description: See or change files and folders on the person's Mac. A bare name is looked for in the open Finder window and the usual folders. selected means what is selected in Finder.

path.description: The file or folder acted on. For list and find, the folder to look in.

to.description: For move, the folder to move it into.

name.description: For rename, the new name. For new_folder, its name.

query.description: For find, part of the name or a kind such as pdf.

tools.name: browser
tools.description: Use the web browser the person already has open, in their own tabs.

url.description: For go, the address to load in the current tab; for new_tab, an optional address.

tab.description: For switch, the tab number from tabs.

tools.name: input
tools.description: Type, press keys, or click in the app in front, when the other tools cannot do it. Look at the screen afterwards.

keys.description: For keys, like cmd+f, enter, escape.

label.description: For click, the visible name of the button or item.

x.description: For click without a name, 0 to 1 across the shared screen.
